name: University of Basel
summary: Basel's university, founded in 1460; bachelor's degrees are taught mainly in German, and English can be one of two BA subjects.

ib.text: 32/42 in six subjects across Basel's six groups, with a science or maths at HL; Psychology or Music can be the sixth subject. Basel advises German at C1 before you start.

notes: For autumn 2026 the deadline was 30 April, with late requests to 31 July for a CHF 150 fee; the autumn 2027 dates are not yet published.
English can be one of your two BA subjects and is taught almost entirely in English, but the other subject is usually in German.
Medicine is open to non-Swiss applicants only in narrow cases, such as a Swiss settlement permit or a year of related work in Switzerland.
